interpretation.priority: INP is the weakest aggregate indicator; LCP p75 is close to the 2.5 second boundary; aggregate CLS is healthy.
interpretation.sampleBias: The secondary-results page supplied most report views, so these aggregate rates are not treated as route-balanced evidence for student, admin, teacher, assistant, employee, or support surfaces.
interpretation.deploymentPolicy: No fixed RUM duration or sample count blocks deployment. Immediate synthetic, workflow, resource, health, and error gates block; post-release RUM always reports its sample count.

limitations.conclusion: Ingress and landing/live health were healthy, but authenticated, database-heavy, write, and websocket workflows were not exercised.
